newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen firm on stable rupiah.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen firm on stable rupiah.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen firm on Wednesday, with players seen buying selected blue chips following general stability in the currency market, brokers said.
"Blue chips are likely to be the market focus again due to the stable rupiah," one broker said.
Rupiah was traded at 2,568.00/73.00 against the dollar at 0155 GMT compared with 2,565.00/75.00 at the opening.
Jakarta stocks staged a modest rebound on Tuesday as investors bought back selected blue chips including Telkom and BNI on the back of the stable rupiah, brokers said.
On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index rose 5.54 points to close at 716.36 points.
Brokers said recent announcements of rises in the first half net profits of some second-liners were expected to further boost sentiment.
Among the stocks to watch were Bank Niaga on news of a proposed share purchase and finance firm Putra Surya Multidana on reports of a planned 700 billion rupiah bond, brokers said.
